title: MutableDataFrame length setter for strict mode object cloning
answers: Why does Explore raw Prometheus view throw TypeError: Cannot set property length of which has only a getter?
How to fix TypeError Cannot set property length of which has only a getter when cloning MutableDataFrame
Why does lodash cloneDeep fail on MutableDataFrame in Rspack ESM builds?
How to make DataFrame classes compatible with lodash cloneDeep in strict mode
body:
Symptom: In Explore, viewing the raw Prometheus view fails with "TypeError: Cannot set property length of #<d> which has only a getter" when running two or more instant queries.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/dataframe/MutableDataFrame.ts:MutableDataFrame.length only had a getter for derived length, causing strict-mode lodash cloneDeep (used on merged queries in public/app/features/explore/PrometheusListView/RawListContainer.tsx:RawListContainer) to fail when reassigning keys.
Fix pattern: Add a no-op setter (`set length(_value: number) {}`) to classes whose derived properties are read and written back by generic object cloners, and remove unnecessary cloneDeep calls on read-only data.
Constraints: Applies to class properties with getters that generic cloners reassign in strict ESM environments; does not apply if writing to the property should actually update internal collection state.
applies: Grafana frontend data frame classes and Explore views handling cloned data under strict ESM / Rspack builds
